mo_ta_cong_viec:
1. As a Software PM, you will:
Lead end-to-end product development projects, from early discovery and idea validation to delivery and post-launch support.
Work closely with founders and stakeholders to clarify product vision, refine business goals, and translate ambiguous ideas into structured roadmaps and execution plans.
Act not only as a project manager, but also as a product-thinking partner — proactively identifying risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities in both business and technical aspects.
Define project scope, objectives, timelines, and success metrics aligned with product outcomes.
Prepare and manage budgets based on scope, team structure, and delivery strategy.
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget, while maintaining high product quality and customer satisfaction.
Manage client relationships professionally, serving as a trusted advisor rather than just a task coordinator.
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement definitions, roadmaps, risk logs, and performance tracking.
Measure project and product performance to identify areas for improvement and optimization.
Nice to Have (Additional Advantage):
Strong Business Analysis capability (requirement elicitation, stakeholder mapping, process modeling, product validation).
Experience working in product studio environments or building products from early-stage ideas.
Hands-on experience utilizing AI tools in project delivery (e.g., ChatGPT, coding agents, AI-assisted documentation, backlog generation, workflow automation).
yeu_cau:
At least 3–5 years of experience in software project management.
Proficient in both verbal and written English (ielts >=7.0). Be able to communicate with customer on daily basis.
Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and facilitating all Scrum ceremonies.
Scrum certification such as PSM I, CSM, or an equivalent certification.
Demonstrated ability to:
Coordinate and facilitate meeting discussions effectively.
Proactively ask questions, clarify requirements, and define clear action items.
Monitor project progress, risks, dependencies, and team commitments.
Manage Jira, product backlog, sprint planning, and release planning.
Prepare clear and well-structured reports, meeting minutes, and project documentation.
Communicate transparently and proactively escalate issues when necessary.
